questions.question: Find the length of the longest diagonal (in cm) of a cuboidal box of dimensions 1.2 cm × 1.3 cm × 1.5 cm (correct to two decimal places).
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The length of the longest diagonal in a cuboid is calculated using the formula: **√(l² + b² + h²)**

⇒ Diagonal = √(1.2² + 1.3² + 1.5²)

⇒ Diagonal = √(1.44 + 1.69 + 2.25)

⇒ Diagonal = √5.38

⇒ Since 2.31² = 5.3361 and 2.32² = 5.3824, √5.38 is approximately 2.32.

**∴ The correct answer is 2.32 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length (l) = 1.5 cm

Breadth (b) = 1.3 cm

Height (h) = 1.2 cm

**Formula Used:**

Length of the longest diagonal of a cuboidal box = √(l² + b² + h²)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2c8fe200fc52d5f61162a9e35d1623b15c3b96b4a5b2fc09139c7accf107f44b.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Diagonal = √(1.5² + 1.3² + 1.2²)

⇒ Diagonal = √(2.25 + 1.69 + 1.44)

⇒ Diagonal = √5.38

⇒ Upon checking squares of nearest numbers, 2.31² = 5.3361 and 2.32² = 5.3824.

⇒ The value 5.38 is closest to 5.3824.

⇒ Therefore, √5.38 ≈ 2.32 cm (correct to two decimal places).

**∴ The correct answer is 2.32 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area of a Cuboid

The total surface area encompasses all six rectangular faces of the cuboid. Formula: TSA = 2(lb + bh + hl)

Volume of a Cuboid

The volume represents the total three-dimensional space enclosed by the cuboid. Formula: V = l × b × h

Diagonal of a Cube

For a cube where all sides are strictly equal (l = b = h = a), the length of the longest diagonal simplifies directly to a√3.
</p

questions.question: If x is an integer such that x + (1)/(x) = (65)/(8), then find the value of x - (1)/(x)
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Given: x + 1/x = 65/8

Express 65/8 as a mixed fraction: 65/8 = 8 + 1/8

By comparing x + 1/x with 8 + 1/8, we can clearly see x = 8 or x = 1/8.

Since x is stated to be an integer, we take x = 8.

Therefore, x − 1/x = 8 − 1/8 = (64 − 1)/8 = 63/8.

**∴ The correct answer is 63/8.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

x + 1/x = 65/8

x is an integer.

**Calculation:**

⇒ (x² + 1) / x = 65/8

By cross-multiplying, we get:

⇒ 8(x² + 1) = 65x

⇒ 8x² − 65x + 8 = 0

⇒ 8x² − 64x − x + 8 = 0

⇒ 8x(x − 8) − 1(x − 8) = 0

⇒ (8x − 1)(x − 8) = 0

⇒ x = 1/8 or x = 8

Since it is given that x is an integer, x = 8.

Now, we substitute x = 8 in the expression x − 1/x:

⇒ x − 1/x = 8 − 1/8

⇒ (64 − 1) / 8

⇒ 63/8

**∴ The correct answer is 63/8.**

**__Additional Information__**

Algebraic Identities for Reciprocals

The relationship between the sum and difference of a number and its reciprocal is given by: (x + 1/x)² − (x − 1/x)² = 4.

Nature of Roots in Quadratic Equations

For a quadratic equation ax² + bx + c = 0, the sum of roots is −b/a and the product of roots is c/a. This helps quickly verify roots.

Reciprocal Roots Rule

When the coefficient of x² equals the constant term (a = c), the product of the roots is 1, meaning the two roots are reciprocals of each other.
</p

questions.question: Arvind and Chetan started running simultaneously from the same point in the same direction on a circular track of length 210 m. If Arvind takes 180 seconds to complete one round, and Chetan takes 420 seconds to complete one round, after how much time will they meet for the first time at the starting point on the track?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Time taken by Arvind to complete one round = 180 seconds = 3 minutes.

Time taken by Chetan to complete one round = 420 seconds = 7 minutes.

To find the time they meet for the first time at the starting point, we calculate the LCM of their individual lap times.

Meeting time = LCM(3, 7) = 21 minutes.

**∴ The correct answer is 21 minutes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length of circular track = 210 m

Time taken by Arvind (T₁) = 180 seconds

Time taken by Chetan (T₂) = 420 seconds

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d3f3d0dadcdbfb6f2f5ebccd64d5bb528d1c478001af304c84d8ffdbcc9c5153.png] 

**Formula Used:**

Time to meet for the first time at the starting point = LCM of individual times taken to complete one round.

**Calculations:**

⇒ Prime factorization of 180 = 2² × 3² × 5

⇒ Prime factorization of 420 = 2² × 3 × 5 × 7

⇒ LCM(180, 420) = 2² × 3² × 5 × 7

⇒ LCM(180, 420) = 4 × 9 × 5 × 7 = 1260 seconds

⇒ Convert total seconds into minutes = 1260 ÷ 60

⇒ Time to meet = 21 minutes

**∴ The correct answer is 21 minutes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Meeting First Time at Starting Point

When multiple people start from the same point simultaneously, they meet again at the starting point exactly at the LCM of the times taken by each to complete one full round independently.

Meeting First Time Anywhere on Track

If running in the same direction, Time to meet = Track Length ÷ (S₁ − S₂). If running in opposite directions, Time to meet = Track Length ÷ (S₁ + S₂).

Number of Distinct Meeting Points

If the ratio of their speeds is a : b in its simplest form, they will meet at (a − b) distinct points if running in the same direction, and at (a + b) distinct points if running in opposite directions.
</p

questions.question: If P is a digit such that 6954P is divisible by 11, then P equals:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Apply the divisibility rule of 11 directly:

Sum of alternate digits (odd places) = 6 + 5 + P = 11 + P

Sum of remaining digits (even places) = 9 + 4 = 13

Difference = (11 + P) − 13 = P − 2

For divisibility by 11, P − 2 = 0 ⇒ P = 2

**∴ The correct answer is 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

A 5-digit number 6954P is exactly divisible by 11.

P is a single digit (0 to 9).

**Method Used:**

A number is divisible by 11 if the difference between the sum of digits at odd positions and the sum of digits at even positions is either 0 or a multiple of 11.

**Calculations:**

⇒ Sum of digits at odd places (1st, 3rd, 5th from right) = P + 5 + 6 = 11 + P

⇒ Sum of digits at even places (2nd, 4th from right) = 4 + 9 = 13

⇒ Difference = (11 + P) − 13

⇒ Difference = P − 2

⇒ For the difference to be a multiple of 11, the only possible value for a single digit P (0 ≤ P ≤ 9) is when the difference is exactly 0.

⇒ P − 2 = 0

⇒ P = 2

**∴ The correct answer is 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Divisibility Rule of 3 and 9

A number is divisible by 3 (or 9) if the sum of its digits is exactly divisible by 3 (or 9).

Divisibility Rule of 4 and 8

A number is divisible by 4 if its last two digits form a number divisible by 4. It is divisible by 8 if its last three digits form a number divisible by 8.

Combined Divisibility Rule of 7, 11, and 13

Form alternating sums of blocks of three digits from right to left. If the resultant difference is divisible by 7, 11, or 13, then the original number is also divisible by 7, 11, or 13 respectively.
</p

questions.question: In a bank, 6% interest is given on the deposited amount. The bank then invests the money in the stock market and is able to earn ₹30,000 for every ₹3,00,000. How much money is the bank earning finally if the total amount deposited in the bank is ₹60,00,000?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Bank's earning rate from the stock market = (30,000 ÷ 3,00,000) × 100 = 10%

Interest rate paid to depositors = 6%

Net profit margin for the bank = 10% − 6% = 4%

Final earnings of the bank = 4% of 60,00,000

Final earnings = (4 ÷ 100) × 60,00,000 = ₹2,40,000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹2,40,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total amount deposited in the bank = ₹60,00,000

Interest given on deposited amount = 6%

Earnings from stock market = ₹30,000 for every ₹3,00,000

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/21481ce06a762860c613ac9fc3bddffabe9d75e7744068e1e9faa5197d4ad563.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total interest paid to depositors = 6% of ₹60,00,000

⇒ Total interest paid = (6 ÷ 100) × 60,00,000 = ₹3,60,000

⇒ Total money invested in the stock market by the bank = ₹60,00,000

⇒ Bank's total earnings from the market = (60,00,000 ÷ 3,00,000) × 30,000

⇒ Bank's total earnings = 20 × 30,000 = ₹6,00,000

⇒ Final earnings of the bank = Earnings from stock market − Interest paid to depositors

⇒ Final earnings = 6,00,000 − 3,60,000 = ₹2,40,000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹2,40,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Return on Investment (ROI)

ROI is a performance measure used to evaluate the efficiency of an investment. Formula: ROI = (Net Profit ÷ Cost of Investment) × 100.

Net Yield / Margin

It represents the core difference between the rate an institution earns on investments and the rate it pays on its obligations. Net Margin = Earning Rate − Borrowing Rate.

Simple Percentage Computation

When base values are uniform throughout the problem, percentages can be subtracted directly to calculate final absolute differences (e.g., 10% − 6% = 4% on the common base).

questions.question: If cosec x = (5)/(4) , then the vale of = frac{5sin²x + 8cot²x}{27tan²x - 125cos²x} is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Given cosec x = 5/4 ⇒ Hypotenuse = 5, Perpendicular = 4, and Base = 3.

From this, sin x = 4/5, cos x = 3/5, tan x = 4/3, and cot x = 3/4.

⇒ Numerator = 5 × (4/5)² + 8 × (3/4)² = 16/5 + 9/2 = 77/10

⇒ Denominator = 27 × (4/3)² − 125 × (3/5)² = 48 − 45 = 3

⇒ Final Value = (77/10) ÷ 3 = 77/30

**∴ The correct answer is 77/30.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

⇒ cosec x = 5/4

We know that cosec x = Hypotenuse / Perpendicular

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/01e842f33feef4d756daa7d0a1ba4ef4da3660faffef8bbaf7bdb5067c3a9233.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let Hypotenuse (H) = 5 and Perpendicular (P) = 4

Using Pythagoras theorem:

⇒ Base (B) = √(H² − P²)

⇒ Base (B) = √(5² − 4²) = √(25 − 16) = √9 = 3

Now, finding the required trigonometric ratios:

⇒ sin x = P / H = 4/5

⇒ cos x = B / H = 3/5

⇒ tan x = P / B = 4/3

⇒ cot x = B / P = 3/4

Solving the numerator of the expression: 5sin²x + 8cot²x

⇒ Numerator = 5 × (4/5)² + 8 × (3/4)²

⇒ Numerator = 5 × (16/25) + 8 × (9/16)

⇒ Numerator = 16/5 + 9/2 = (32 + 45) / 10 = 77/10

Solving the denominator of the expression: 27tan²x − 125cos²x

⇒ Denominator = 27 × (4/3)² − 125 × (3/5)²

⇒ Denominator = 27 × (16/9) − 125 × (9/25)

⇒ Denominator = (3 × 16) − (5 × 9) = 48 − 45 = 3

Dividing numerator by denominator:

⇒ Value = (77/10) ÷ 3 = 77/30

**∴ The correct answer is 77/30.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Trigonometric Ratios

sin θ = Perpendicular / Hypotenuse, cos θ = Base / Hypotenuse, and tan θ = Perpendicular / Base.

Pythagoras Theorem

In a right-angled triangle, the square of the hypotenuse is equal to the sum of the squares of the other two sides (H² = P² + B²).

Trigonometric Identities

The three fundamental identities are sin²θ + cos²θ = 1, 1 + tan²θ = sec²θ, and 1 + cot²θ = cosec²θ.
</p

questions.question: 42 litres of milk at ₹25 per litre is mixed with 28 litres of milk at ₹40 per litre. Find the average price of the mixture.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of milk quantities = 42 : 28 = 3 : 2

Weighted Avg = (Ratio₁ × P₁ + Ratio₂ × P₂) ÷ (Ratio₁ + Ratio₂)

⇒ Average = (3 × 25 + 2 × 40) ÷ (3 + 2)

⇒ Average = (75 + 80) ÷ 5 = 155 ÷ 5 = ₹31

**∴ The correct answer is ₹31.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Quantity of first milk = 42 litres, Price = ₹25/litre

Quantity of second milk = 28 litres, Price = ₹40/litre

**Formula Used:**

Average Price = Total Cost ÷ Total Quantity

 
• 
 
• 
 
• 
 
• 
 
 ₹25
 
 ₹40
 
 ₹ x
 Average
 
 40 − x
 
 x − 25
 42 L → 3 parts
 28 L → 2 parts

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total Cost = (42 × 25) + (28 × 40)

⇒ Total Cost = 1050 + 1120 = 2170

⇒ Total Quantity = 42 + 28 = 70

⇒ Average Price = 2170 ÷ 70

⇒ Average Price = 31

Alternatively, using the Alligation method from the diagram:

⇒ (40 − x) ÷ (x − 25) = 42 ÷ 28

⇒ (40 − x) ÷ (x − 25) = 3 ÷ 2

⇒ 2 × (40 − x) = 3 × (x − 25)

⇒ 80 − 2x = 3x − 75

⇒ 5x = 155 ⇒ x = 31

**∴ The correct answer is ₹31.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Rule of Alligation

When two ingredients of different prices are mixed, the ratio of their quantities is given by: (Cheaper Quantity) ÷ (Dearer Quantity) = (Price of Dearer − Mean Price) ÷ (Mean Price − Price of Cheaper).

Weighted Average

It calculates the average of values with different weights or quantities. Formula: Aw = (w₁x₁ + w₂x₂) ÷ (w₁ + w₂).

questions.question: In triangle ABC, D is the mid-point of BC. If DL perpendicular to AB and DM perpendicular to AC such that DL = DM, then the triangle will be:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Since D is the midpoint of BC, the hypotenuses BD and CD are equal.

The perpendiculars from D to sides AB and AC are also equal, so DL = DM.

In right-angled ΔBLD and ΔCMD, both the hypotenuses and one side are equal.

By RHS congruence, ΔBLD ≅ ΔCMD, which implies the base angles are equal (∠B = ∠C).

If two angles of a triangle are equal, the opposite sides are also equal (AB = AC).

**∴ The correct answer is isosceles triangle.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 
 
• 
• 
• 
 
 
• 
• 
• 
• 
• 
• A B C D L M 

**Given:**

In ΔABC, D is the mid-point of BC ⇒ BD = DC

DL ⊥ AB and DM ⊥ AC ⇒ ∠BLD = ∠CMD = 90°

Lengths of the perpendiculars are equal ⇒ DL = DM

**Proof:**

In right-angled ΔBLD and right-angled ΔCMD:

⇒ ∠BLD = ∠CMD = 90° (Given)

⇒ Hypotenuse BD = Hypotenuse DC (D is the mid-point of BC)

⇒ Side DL = Side DM (Given)

⇒ By RHS (Right angle - Hypotenuse - Side) congruence criterion, ΔBLD ≅ ΔCMD.

Therefore, the corresponding parts are equal:

⇒ ∠LBD = ∠MCD (CPCT)

⇒ ∠B = ∠C

In any triangle, the sides opposite to equal angles are always equal in length.

⇒ AB = AC

⇒ Since two sides of ΔABC are equal, it must be an isosceles triangle.

**∴ The correct answer is isosceles triangle.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Congruence Criteria (RHS)

Two right-angled triangles are congruent if the hypotenuse and one side of one triangle are respectively equal to the hypotenuse and one side of the second triangle.

Properties of Isosceles Triangles

An isosceles triangle has at least two equal sides and two equal base angles. The median drawn to the unequal side always acts as the altitude and the angle bisector.

Equidistant Property of an Angle Bisector

Any point lying on the bisector of an angle is strictly equidistant from the arms of that angle. Here, D being equidistant from AB and AC implies AD bisects ∠A.

questions.question: The marked price of a TV set is ₹18,500. If the dealer allows two successive discounts of 20% and 5%, for how much is the TV available?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Effective Multiplier = (100 − D₁)% × (100 − D₂)%

SP = 18500 × 80% × 95%

SP = 18500 × (4/5) × (19/20)

SP = 18500 × (76/100) = 14060

**∴ The correct answer is ₹14,060.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Marked Price (MP) of TV set = ₹18,500

First successive discount (D₁) = 20%

Second successive discount (D₂) = 5%

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9c577f5c58e7b4543fb433d2538fc7613041d1fcc9e3d5bc2aa370fb23c156e7.png] 

**Formula Used:**

Selling Price (SP) = MP × (100 − D₁)/100 × (100 − D₂)/100

**Calculations:**

⇒ Price after 1st discount = 18500 × (100 − 20)/100

⇒ Price after 1st discount = 18500 × 80/100 = 18500 × 4/5 = ₹14,800

⇒ Price after 2ⁿd discount = 14800 × (100 − 5)/100

⇒ Final Selling Price = 14800 × 95/100 = 148 × 95

⇒ Final Selling Price = ₹14,060

**∴ The correct answer is ₹14,060.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Discount Formula

For two successive discounts of x% and y%, the equivalent single discount can also be found directly using the formula: [x + y − (x × y) ÷ 100]%.

Marked Price (MP)

The listed, printed, or tagged price of an article. Unless specified otherwise, all discount percentages are always calculated on the Marked Price.

Selling Price (SP)

The final amount paid by a customer. It connects directly to Marked Price via SP = MP − Discount, and to Cost Price via SP = CP + Profit.

questions.question: Ajay spends 66(2)/(3)% of his income on different household items. If his income increases by 25% and expenditure increase by 20%, then the effect on his savings will be:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Since Expenditure is 66(2/3)% = 2/3 of Income, let Income = 3 units, Expenditure = 2 units, and Savings = 1 unit.

Using weighted average: (Exp Ratio × Exp % Change) + (Sav Ratio × Sav % Change) = (Inc Ratio × Inc % Change)

⇒ 2 × 20% + 1 × x = 3 × 25%

⇒ 40% + x = 75%

⇒ x = 35%

**∴ The correct answer is 35%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/291a8a2365031f33b1beb161cbabb47a483157230249e008c0dbac76fbcc0f23.png] 

**Given:**

⇒ Expenditure = 66(2/3)% of Income = 2/3 × Income

Let initial Income = 300

**Calculations:**

⇒ Initial Expenditure = 2/3 × 300 = 200

⇒ Initial Savings = Income − Expenditure = 300 − 200 = 100

⇒ New Income = 300 + (25/100 × 300) = 300 + 75 = 375

⇒ New Expenditure = 200 + (20/100 × 200) = 200 + 40 = 240

⇒ New Savings = New Income − New Expenditure = 375 − 240 = 135

⇒ Increase in Savings = 135 − 100 = 35

⇒ Percentage effect on Savings = (35 ÷ 100) × 100% = 35%

**∴ The correct answer is 35%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Income, Expenditure & Savings Relationship

Income = Expenditure + Savings. The overall percentage change in income acts as the weighted average of the percentage changes in expenditure and savings.

Mixture & Alligation Approach

This problem type can also be effectively solved using the Alligation cross method on percentage changes, where Ratio of Expenditure to Savings = (Savings % Change − Income % Change) : (Income % Change − Expenditure % Change).

Percentage Change Formula

Percentage Change = (Final Value − Initial Value) ÷ Initial Value × 100%. A positive resulting value indicates an increase, while a negative value signifies a decrease.

questions.question: A function of two variable varies directly with x and inversely with y. Determine function when x = 5 and y = 3. Given that, for x = 0 and y = 1, f = 15 and for x = 1 and y = 15, f = 2.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Let the function be a sum of direct and inverse variations: f = ax + b/y.

For x = 0, y = 1: f = 15 ⇒ a(0) + b/1 = 15 ⇒ b = 15.

For x = 1, y = 15: f = 2 ⇒ a(1) + 15/15 = 2 ⇒ a = 1.

The determined function is f = x + 15/y.

For x = 5 and y = 3: f = 5 + 15/3 = 5 + 5 = 10.

**∴ The correct answer is 10.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

A function f(x, y) consists of two parts:

One part varies directly with x.

One part varies inversely with y.

f = 15 when x = 0 and y = 1.

f = 2 when x = 1 and y = 15.

**Formula Used:**

f = a × x + b ÷ y

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f822fe4cad76a7ea314483b77a43a3020ab01fa9b6c93460f183b84a64651450.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Step 1: Substitute the first condition (x = 0, y = 1, f = 15) into the formula.

⇒ 15 = a × 0 + b ÷ 1

⇒ b = 15

⇒ Step 2: Substitute the second condition (x = 1, y = 15, f = 2) into the formula.

⇒ 2 = a × 1 + 15 ÷ 15

⇒ 2 = a + 1

⇒ a = 1

⇒ The complete function equation is f = x + 15/y.

⇒ Step 3: Find f when x = 5 and y = 3.

⇒ f = 5 + 15 ÷ 3

⇒ f = 5 + 5

⇒ f = 10

**∴ The correct answer is 10.**

**__Additional Information__**

Direct Variation

If two quantities A and B are in direct variation, they increase or decrease together proportionally. The equation takes the form A = k × B, where k is a constant.

Inverse Variation

If two quantities A and B are in inverse variation, an increase in one causes a proportional decrease in the other. The equation takes the form A = k ÷ B.

Partial Variation

When a value depends on the sum of two or more independent variables or conditions, it is expressed as a combined sum of multiple variations. Example: f = a × x + b ÷ y.
</p

questions.question: In how many years will ₹7,200 amount to ₹8,928 at a simple interest rate of 8% per annum?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Simple Interest = ₹8,928 − ₹7,200 = ₹1,728

Interest for 1 year = 8% of ₹7,200 = ₹576

Time = Total Interest ÷ 1 Year Interest = 1728 ÷ 576 = 3 years

**∴ The correct answer is 3 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹7,200

Amount (A) = ₹8,928

Rate (R) = 8% per annum

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1b19ec7c90ee5ae98a61abbfab30d75f9ad5479ce405ff3a41f8e4c8c9b22093.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ SI = Amount − Principal

⇒ SI = 8928 − 7200 = ₹1728

⇒ Using formula: SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

⇒ 1728 = (7200 × 8 × T) ÷ 100

⇒ 1728 = 72 × 8 × T

⇒ 1728 = 576 × T

⇒ T = 1728 ÷ 576

⇒ T = 3

**∴ The correct answer is 3 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest Formula

Simple Interest is calculated on the principal amount for the entire duration. SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100.

Amount in Simple Interest

The total amount (A) at the end of the time period is the sum of Principal and Simple Interest. A = P + SI = P[1 + (R × T) ÷ 100].

Difference between SI and CI

For the first year, SI and CI are exactly the same if compounded annually. For subsequent years, CI is calculated on the accumulated amount, whereas SI remains constant each year.

questions.question: If tan(A) = (3)/(5), then cos(A) is equal to:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Given tan(A) = 3/5 = Perpendicular / Base.

Hypotenuse = √(3² + 5²) = √(9 + 25) = √34.

cos(A) = Base / Hypotenuse = 5 / √34.

**∴ The correct answer is 5/√34.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7bab33ee069488df2b03ebd341e3aa931f9adc049ddf1ca0d61ecd88f8c2f575.png] 

**Given:**

tan(A) = 3/5

**Formula Used:**

tan(A) = Perpendicular / Base

cos(A) = Base / Hypotenuse

Hypotenuse² = Perpendicular² + Base²

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let Perpendicular (P) = 3x and Base (B) = 5x

⇒ Hypotenuse (H) = √(P² + B²)

⇒ H = √((3x)² + (5x)²)

⇒ H = √(9x² + 25x²)

⇒ H = √(34x²) = x√34

⇒ cos(A) = B / H

⇒ cos(A) = 5x / (x√34)

⇒ cos(A) = 5 / √34

**∴ The correct answer is 5/√34.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Trigonometric Identities

Three fundamental identities are: sin²(A) + cos²(A) = 1, 1 + tan²(A) = sec²(A), and 1 + cot²(A) = cosec²(A).

Reciprocal Relations

The reciprocal of sine is cosecant, cosine is secant, and tangent is cotangent: cosec(A) = 1/sin(A), sec(A) = 1/cos(A), cot(A) = 1/tan(A).

Pythagoras Theorem

In any right-angled triangle, the square of the hypotenuse is equal to the sum of the squares of the other two sides: H² = P² + B².

questions.question: If sin θ + cos θ = sqrt{3} cos θ, then the value of cot θ is:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Divide the given equation by cos θ:

tan θ + 1 = √3 ⇒ tan θ = √3 − 1

Since cot θ = 1 / tan θ, we get cot θ = 1 / (√3 − 1)

Multiply numerator and denominator by (√3 + 1):

cot θ = (√3 + 1) / ((√3)² − 1²) = (√3 + 1) / 2

**∴ The correct answer is (√3 + 1)/2.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

sin θ + cos θ = √3 cos θ

**Calculations:**

⇒ sin θ = √3 cos θ − cos θ

Take cos θ common on the right side:

⇒ sin θ = (√3 − 1) cos θ

We know that cot θ = cos θ / sin θ

⇒ cos θ / sin θ = 1 / (√3 − 1)

⇒ cot θ = 1 / (√3 − 1)

Rationalising the denominator by multiplying and dividing by (√3 + 1):

⇒ cot θ = [1 × (√3 + 1)] / [(√3 − 1) × (√3 + 1)]

Using the algebraic identity (a − b)(a + b) = a² − b²:

⇒ cot θ = (√3 + 1) / (3 − 1)

⇒ cot θ = (√3 + 1) / 2

**∴ The correct answer is (√3 + 1)/2.**

**__Additional Information__**

Trigonometric Identities

sin² θ + cos² θ = 1, 1 + tan² θ = sec² θ, and 1 + cot² θ = cosec² θ.

Trigonometric Ratios

tan θ = sin θ / cos θ and cot θ = cos θ / sin θ. The reciprocal relations are sin θ = 1 / cosec θ, cos θ = 1 / sec θ, and tan θ = 1 / cot θ.

Rationalisation

When the denominator contains a surd, we multiply the numerator and denominator by its conjugate to rationalize it, applying the rule (a + b)(a − b) = a² − b².
</p

questions.question: A circular arc makes an angle of 15° at the centre. If the radius of the circular arc is 14 cm, what is the perimeter (correct up to two decimal places) of the sector so formed? (π = 3.14)?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The perimeter of a sector is the sum of its arc length (l) and twice its radius (2r).

Arc Length (l) = (θ ÷ 360°) × 2πr

l = (15° ÷ 360°) × 2 × 3.14 × 14

l = (1 ÷ 24) × 87.92 ≈ 3.66 cm

Perimeter = l + 2r = 3.66 + 2(14) = 3.66 + 28 = 31.66 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 31.66 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5fdd692ae6c7f7e44cdbd7ef0fca777e3cb0c7950019a13d94c96ae827421d48.png] 

**Given:**

Angle of the circular arc (θ) = 15°

Radius of the circular arc (r) = 14 cm

Value of π = 3.14

**Formula Used:**

Length of Arc (l) = (θ ÷ 360°) × 2πr

Perimeter of a Sector = Length of Arc + 2 × Radius

**Calculations:**

⇒ l = (15 ÷ 360) × 2 × 3.14 × 14

⇒ l = (1 ÷ 24) × 87.92

⇒ l = 87.92 ÷ 24

⇒ l ≈ 3.6633 cm

⇒ Perimeter of the Sector = l + 2r

⇒ Perimeter = 3.6633 + (2 × 14)

⇒ Perimeter = 3.6633 + 28

⇒ Perimeter = 31.6633 cm

⇒ Rounding up to two decimal places, Perimeter = 31.66 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 31.66 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Area of a Sector

The area of a sector with central angle θ is given by A = (θ ÷ 360°) × πr². Alternatively, if the arc length l is known, the area can be directly calculated as A = (l × r) ÷ 2.

Length of a Circular Arc

The arc length represents the distance along the curved edge of the circle and is calculated as l = (θ ÷ 360°) × 2πr.

Perimeter vs Arc Length

Students often confuse the perimeter of a sector with the arc length. The arc length is merely the curved boundary, while the full perimeter of the sector must include the two straight radii boundary lines, establishing the formula: Perimeter = l + 2r.
</p

questions.question: There are y yellow marbles and b blue marbles in a box. 18% of the yellow marbles were added to 24% of the blue marbles, and the total was 30. Three times the number of yellow marbles exceeds two times the number of blue marbles by 200. What is the ratio of y² to b² ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

From the first statement, 18% of y + 24% of b = 30 ⇒ 3y + 4b = 500.

From the second statement, 3y − 2b = 200.

Subtracting the second equation from the first gives 6b = 300 ⇒ b = 50.

Substituting b = 50 into 3y − 2b = 200 gives 3y = 300 ⇒ y = 100.

The ratio of y to b is 100 : 50 = 2 : 1, so y² : b² = 2² : 1² = 4 : 1.

**∴ The correct answer is 4 : 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

18% of yellow marbles (y) + 24% of blue marbles (b) = 30

Three times yellow marbles − Two times blue marbles = 200

⇒ 18y + 24b = 3000

Dividing the entire equation by 6, we get:

⇒ 3y + 4b = 500 ... (Equation 1)

From the second condition given in the question:

Subtracting Equation 2 from Equation 1:

**∴ The correct answer is 4 : 1.**

Duplicate Ratio

The ratio of the squares of two numbers is known as their duplicate ratio. For a base ratio of a : b, the duplicate ratio is calculated as a² : b².

Sub-duplicate Ratio

The ratio of the square roots of two values is known as the sub-duplicate ratio. For a base ratio of a : b, it is written as √a : √b.

Linear Equations Elimination

When solving two linear equations, making the coefficient of one variable identical and subtracting the equations is a highly efficient way to eliminate that variable and find the other.

Maximum possible length of a single side [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Calculations:**

⇒ The perimeter is the sum of all sides: a + b + c = 52

⇒ From the triangle inequality theorem: a + b > c

⇒ Add 'c' to both sides of the inequality:

Triangle Inequality Theorem (Difference)

The difference between the lengths of any two sides of a triangle is always strictly less than the length of the third side (|a − b| < c).

Perimeter & Semi-perimeter

The perimeter is the total boundary length (P = a + b + c). The semi-perimeter (s) is half of the perimeter (s = P ÷ 2), heavily used in Heron's formula for the area: Area = √[s(s − a)(s − b)(s − c)].

Types of Triangles Based on Sides

questions.question: Two pipes can fill a tank in 12 hours and 18 hours, respectively, while a third pipe can empty it in 8 hours. How long (in hours) will it take to fill the empty tank if all three pipes are opened simultaneously?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Capacity (Total Work) = LCM(12, 18, 8) = 72 units.

Combined Efficiency = (72 ÷ 12) + (72 ÷ 18) − (72 ÷ 8)

⇒ 6 + 4 − 9 = 1 unit/hour.

Time required to fill the tank = Total Capacity ÷ Combined Efficiency = 72 ÷ 1 = 72 hours.

**∴ The correct answer is 72 hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by Pipe 1 to fill the tank = 12 hours

Time taken by Pipe 2 to fill the tank = 18 hours

Time taken by Pipe 3 to empty the tank = 8 hours

**Method Used:** LCM Method

 
 

 **Pipe**
 **Hours**
 **Total Work**
 **Efficiency**
 
 

 Pipe 1
 12
 72
 6
 
 

 Pipe 2
 18
 4
 
 

 Pipe 3 (Outlet)
 8
 −9
 
 

**Calculations:**

⇒ The total combined efficiency when all three pipes are opened simultaneously = 6 + 4 − 9 = 1 unit/hour.

⇒ Time taken to fill the empty tank = Total Work ÷ Net Efficiency

⇒ Time taken = 72 ÷ 1 = 72 hours.

**∴ The correct answer is 72 hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Inlet and Outlet Pipes

An inlet pipe fills the tank (positive efficiency), while an outlet pipe empties it (negative efficiency). The net efficiency of the system is the algebraic sum of their individual efficiencies.

Time and Work Concept

Pipes and cisterns problems are identical to regular time and work problems. The total volume of the tank acts as the Total Work, and the filling/emptying rates act as the working Efficiency.

Fractional Method

If inlet pipes fill a tank in x and y hours, and an outlet pipe empties it in z hours, the net part of the tank filled in 1 hour is given by (1/x) + (1/y) − (1/z).
</p
